note: Numbers for the Skirmish / Distraction engagement. Everything here is a first guess for playtesting.
beatRule: THE RULE OF A BEAT: score = 3 dice + half the stat of your stance (rounded up) + bonuses. The higher score wins; a gap of 0 or 1 is even (stalemateWithin); a gap of 6 or more moves momentum 1 further (decisiveMargin). Dice: beatDice dice of diceSides sides. Half: statWeight. Bonuses: affinityBonus, matchupBonus, momentum.leadBonus, poise.empower, offBalance.contest, and high ground on the opening beat (terrain.json).
diceNote: dice, pressBonus, holdBonus, breakBonus, keepHoldBonus, heightBonusPerLevel and styleStat are only for the older "classic" clash (mode: classic), which the game no longer uses. The live rule is beatRule above.
heightBonusNote: High ground in a clash is worth 2 per level (picked 13 Nov, roadmap 13.52). The same number is in terrain.json as openingHeightBonusPerLevel, which is the one the live stance duel reads: only the fighter who starts the clash gets it, only on the opening beat, and only for standing higher. Keep the two numbers the same (dev/tests/duel-rules.cjs checks it).
weaponDamageNote: Balance pass (roadmap 18.32, 22 Nov): every weapon hit (spear, sword, mace, arrow, dagger) does this much more after defense, before the other bonuses. With attack minus defense alone, hits on the armoured fighters were 1 to 3 (Sudeen on Gadara 1, Gaha on Tayo 4) and bot battles took 107 to 126 turns (17 to 22 rounds). 0 = the old rule. Magic (Lightning, Kofi's bolt) is not changed: it already hit for about 5.
healthScaleNote: Balance pass (roadmap 18.32, 22 Nov): every fighter's health in battle is its health in units.json or jobs.json times this, rounded (Sudeen 48 is 36, Rabdul 34 is 26, Gadara 60 is 45). Suleiman's numbers stay as written; this is one dial for battle length. 1 = the old health. With 1, bot battles took 16 to 18 rounds even with weaponDamageBonus; the aim is 8 to 15.
distractedNote: A fighter locked in a clash with SOMEONE ELSE is Distracted: every other attacker hits it 10 points more often (distractedHitBonus) and for 2 more damage (distractedDamageBonus, 1.77, 21 Nov: before this there was no damage bonus at all). The two in the clash do not get it against each other.
modeNote: "stance" = the stance duel (v0.4). "classic" = the older Engage with Press / Break away.

poise.note: Poise: up to max, a battle starts with start. Each turn OUT of a clash gives back refill; a turn IN a clash gives back refillInClash. Empower spends 1 for +empower to one beat.

beatOddsNote: Odds of a beat, by how far ahead you are before the dice (your half stat and bonuses minus theirs). Lead 0: win 36%, even 27%, lose 36%. Lead 1: 45, 27, 28. Lead 2: 55, 25, 21. Lead 3 (your stance beats theirs, all else equal): 64, 22, 14. Lead 4: 72, 18, 10. Lead 5: 79, 15, 6. Lead 6: 86, 11, 4. Checked by dev/tests/duel-rules.cjs.
rangedBreakNote: An archer caught in a clash cannot shoot, so on its turn it tries to Break away this often (in %), unless it is winning the clash.

signatures.note: Signature stances (Suleiman's tank design). A unit has one if its job in jobs.json has a signature line. Its defence works while it is in a clash and its last stance is the signature stance.

bloodied.note: Bloodied Press (Warlord, Berserker): every hit taken adds a stack. In Press, each stack takes 1 off every hit. Winning a beat with Press lands a quick hit of winHitBase + stacks, and a decisive win pushes 1 tile further.

counter.note: Counter-Press (Bruiser): in Press, the gauntlet soaks up to absorb damage of the first hit after each beat. Every chargePer damage soaked is 1 Charge. Losing a beat releases all Charge as a counter-punch of damagePerCharge per Charge.

riposte.note: Riposte (Gaha, Spearman; roadmap 13.59, numbers from Suleiman's build sheet): each Slip beat he wins adds a stack (up to maxStacks); losing any beat clears them. A won Slip beat hits for winHitBase + the stacks he held before it. A decisive Slip win lets him step to a free tile next to him, ends the clash and leaves the foe Off-Balance (no push).

switchEnds.note: Switch Ends (Rabdul, 19.4, Batch 7): a beat he wins with Press brings the rear blade round for winHit damage (the sheet's baseline 2). One per beat, so no endless chain.

bulwark.note: Bulwark (Warden): each beat in a row held in Guard adds a level. Each level pushes him 1 tile less. An even beat in Guard gives back standoffPoise Poise and standoffHeal health.
bulwark.winHitNote: Batch 7 (21 Nov, Suleiman and Baiyee: Sudeen's strength shows in clashes): a beat he wins with Guard lands a Shield Bash of winHitBase + his Bulwark level (the level counts this beat): 3, then 4, then 5.

enemyClashGapNote: Balance (roadmap 18.15, 14 Nov): after an enemy starts a clash, the whole enemy side waits this many turns (every fighter's turn counts as one) before any enemy starts another. 0 = no wait. Each enemy still waits 6 turns of its own after its clash ends.
stanceChoiceNote: How heroes pick stances in a clash, until the player switches: "auto" (one Fight button picks for you) or "manual" (Press, Guard and Slip buttons). The player's switch is remembered on their device.
